title: Culturally Aware and Adapted NLP: A Taxonomy and a Survey of the State of the Art
findings: The paper does not focus on religion and therefore has no specific findings related to it. Its main contribution is a survey of existing resources and the proposal of a new taxonomy for culture in NLP, identifying research gaps in culturally aware systems.
